title: A/R Collection: the Location chip hides when only one location has data
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Pick an earlier date, date A, on which all of the organization's open A/R documents were at location A.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look for the Location chip.
  2. In the Location menu, untick location B.
  3. Change the as-of date to date A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Location chip shows (two locations in the list).

Step 2:

  • The chip still shows, reading "Location: " and location A's name, so the choice can be undone.

Step 3:

  • The report reloads for date A.
  • The Location chip is not shown: the only location in the list is ticked.

If step 3 keeps location B unticked in the address, tick every location before step 3; the case is about the one-location list.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R9: “The chip is shown whenever the report's list (S5-R3) has two or more locations, and always while fewer than all are ticked, so the choice can always be undone.”
  • S5-N1: “If the organization's open documents sit at only one location and it is ticked, the Location chip is not shown.”
